title: Card distilled brief — fixed slot template (card-distill-free-lane)
description: The ONLY output shape a lane may return from scripts/bench/card-judgment/distill.py. Fixed slots, not freeform summary — anything decisive stays a slot so compression cannot drop it. Underscore keys (_lane, _key) are distiller metadata, not model output.

state.description: One line: where the card actually is (column + what's happening).

open_asks.description: 'none' or the pending requests[] ask — an open ask IS the defer signal.

gates.description: 'none' or the authority gates present: priority:high / review_kind:decide / prod-security tags.

evidence_present.description: 'no' or 'checkable fact present: <what>' — a fact a verify could re-check.

staleness.description: Driven by days since card.updated + comms cadence.

last_action.description: One line: the last thing that happened (comms tail).

needed_move_class.description: execute = rails can run it; decide = Tony's call; correct = live state contradicts card; monitor = check and report only.
